name: Usine Kugler (Fédération des Artistes de Kugler)
funding: Self-managed artist cooperative federation, City of Geneva Cultural Department, Canton of Geneva; non-profit foundation.
watch: Former tap and valve factory on the Arve River transformed by over 200 artists into an autonomous production and exhibition center.

name: Kaskadenkondensator (Kasko)
funding: Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia, Canton of Basel-Stadt Cultural Department, non-profit patron association; artist-run space.
watch: Located in the historic Warteck brewery complex; artist-run project space for performance, process-based art, and feminist collaboration since 1994.

name: Castlefield Gallery
funding: £671k income (FY2025). Arts Council England (to 2027/28), Manchester City Council, Haworth Trust, Brian Mercer Trust, Fenton Arts Trust, corporate and individual donors.
watch: Artist-led registered charity and gallery founded in 1984 on Hewitt Street; champions northern UK artists and affordable studios.
records_note: No annual reports found; accounts are on the Charity Commission register, the support page names patrons and donors undated, and trustees are listed.

name: The Royal Standard
funding: Arts Council England, studio membership fees, non-profit project grants; artist-led registered charity.
watch: Artist-led gallery and studio complex founded in 2006 by four Liverpool artists; 40+ studios and pure DIY energy.

name: Bloc Projects
funding: Arts Council England National Portfolio, Sheffield City Council; artist-led registered charity.
watch: Artist-led project space in a former industrial courtyard in Sheffield; commissions emerging artists and critical research.

name: The NewBridge Project
funding: Arts Council England National Portfolio, Newcastle City Council, National Lottery Heritage Fund; registered charity.
watch: Artist-led community and studio space in Shieldfield; explores social justice, community food, and working-class solidarity.

name: Pallas Projects/Studios
funding: The Arts Council of Ireland (An Chomhairle Ealaíon), Dublin City Council Arts Office; artist-run non-profit organisation.
watch: Founded in 1996 in the historic Coombe / Liberties area; Dublin’s longest-running independent artist-run space.

name: Basic Space
funding: The Arts Council of Ireland, Dublin City Arts Office, project support; nomadic artist-led collective.
watch: Nomadic artist-run organization challenging institutional hierarchies through decentralized, non-commercial projects since 2010.

name: La Casa Encendida
watch: Historic social and cultural center in Lavapiés; non-profit foundation dedicated to avant-garde culture, ecology, and solidarity.

name: Matadero Madrid
watch: Former municipal slaughterhouse converted into a massive public creation center for collaborative arts and ecological thought.

name: PAV - Parco Arte Vivente
funding: City of Turin Cultural Department, Regione Piemonte, Fondazione CRT; non-profit experimental art foundation.
watch: Experimental contemporary art center founded by Arte Povera artist Piero Gilardi, completely dedicated to bio-art and ecology.

name: Fondazione Pastificio Cerere
funding: Fondazione Pastificio Cerere Onlus, Italian Ministry of Culture, Regione Lazio; non-profit foundation.
